name: Майстерня зв’язок (3)
description: A pin party leverages the tactical motif of the pin, exploiting the weakness of a pinned piece. A pinned piece cannot perform its defensive duties effectively. As a result, you can suddenly capture material that seems defended but is not truly protected.

examples.text: The black c-pawn is pinned and therefore cannot carry out its defensive duties effectively. As a result, White wins an important pawn.
After the white queen captures the black knight, Black cannot recapture due to the pin along the g-file.
